title: Human languages are gaining share
author: film-cards
hypothesis: Titles matching the linguistics, translation or Unicode word list take at least 1.25x as much of the story mix in the final three complete weeks as in the first three.
expect: Share of stories in the latest 12 months divided by the pooled share of all earlier stories since 2006: at least 1.25x supports; at or below 1.0x refutes. Between is inconclusive. Title matching only.
thresholds_note: Exploratory. Thresholds copied from the card this one replaces.
caveats: Title matching only: the word list is in scripts/film.py and will miss and mis-match some stories.
Archive scores and comment counts for recent stories are low for all stories, so only ratios against the same months are used.
Associations do not show what causes attention.
